purpose: Teach: ヒューマン/ギア/タブー/シアトル/ロサンゼルス/スターリン/麻雀/アクティブ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お母さんのお仕事はヒューマンなお仕事ね
lines.en: Sho, your mom does such meaningful work, doesn't she?
lines.style: Warm, thoughtful tone. Gentle curiosity inflecting upward at the end. Speaking to him as someone whose opinion matters. Soft, unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、自転車のギア、覚えたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I learned how the bike gears work!
lines.style: Bright, eager voice with genuine pride. Quick delivery on the main fact. Small lift at the end, looking for her recognition. Unguarded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ご家庭のタブーって、お家ごとにあるのね
lines.en: Sho, so every family has its own things you just don't talk about, doesn't it?
lines.style: Slow, thoughtful. She's working through the idea aloud. Gentle, not interrogating. A small pause before the question mark, like she's testing the theory on him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんがシアトル出張に行くんだって
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad's going on a business trip to Seattle!
lines.style: Excited, eager delivery. Quick pace. Leans in with the news. Expects her to share the significance. Open, unguarded enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんはロサンゼルスに行きたいわ
lines.en: Sho, I'd really like to visit Los Angeles someday.
lines.style: Soft longing underneath. Not wistful—more a quiet admission. Slower pace. Looking away slightly, like she's sharing something she doesn't usually say out loud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、図書館でスターリンの本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw a book about Stalin at the library!
lines.style: Bright, eager delivery. Quick pace, like he's bursting to tell her. Small pause before the punchline. Seeking her reaction, her recognition of what he found.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが麻雀好きでいらっしゃるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather really does love mahjong, doesn't he?
lines.style: Gentle observation. Warm, almost amused undertone. Nodding quality to the voice. Respectful—not dismissive of the grandfather, noticing something about family patterns.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お外でアクティブに遊ぶよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm going to go play outside and get lots of energy out!
lines.style: Bright, energetic tone. Quick, forward-moving pace. The momentum of a child about to bolt. Hopeful quality—inviting her approval or just sharing his plan.
